name: Cable Bench Press
steps: Center a flat bench between two low cable pulleys, lie back with feet planted, and hold a handle beside each side of your chest.
Pull your shoulder blades back into the bench and angle your elbows roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press both handles upward and slightly inward until your arms extend directly over your chest.
Lower both handles slowly back beside your chest under steady cable tension.
tips: Keep your wrists and forearms aligned cleanly with the direction of the cable pull.
Avoid letting your shoulders roll forward off the bench at the top of the press.
